parameters.text: Only the Bluejay support team can use these buttons. Nothing was done.

parameters.query:
-- The reply to put in the edit box, only while the draft can still be sent (pending and its ticket's newest draft).
-- Always one row: reply is empty when the draft was already handled or replaced.
select (
  select d.draft->>'client_reply'
  from drafts d
  where d.id = $1::uuid
    and d.status = 'pending'
    and d.created_at = (select max(n.created_at) from drafts n where n.ticket_id = d.ticket_id)
) as reply;

-- First click wins. The draft changes only if it is still open and is its ticket's newest draft: approve and edit
-- need "pending"; take over also works on "agent unavailable", "limit reached" and "client paused". The status
-- check sits in this statement's own WHERE, so a second click that arrives at the same moment waits, re-checks and
-- finds it already decided (no row back).
-- Values in order: 1 draft id, 2 new status, 3 Slack user who clicked, 4 the edited reply ('' = send the draft's
-- own reply)
update drafts d
set status = $2,
    decided_by = $3,
    decided_at = now(),
    draft = case when $2 = 'taken_over' then d.draft
                 else d.draft || jsonb_build_object('sent_reply', coalesce(nullif($4, ''), d.draft->>'client_reply')) end
from tickets t, client_map c
where d.id = $1::uuid
  and (d.status = 'pending' or ($2 = 'taken_over' and d.status in ('agent_unavailable', 'limit_reached', 'client_paused')))
  and d.created_at = (select max(n.created_at) from drafts n where n.ticket_id = d.ticket_id)
  and t.id = d.ticket_id
  and c.channel_id = t.channel_id
returning d.id as draft_id, d.ticket_id, d.status, d.queue_ts, d.draft->>'sent_reply' as sent_reply,
          d.draft->>'likely_cause' as likely_cause, d.draft->'fix_steps' as fix_steps,
          t.channel_id, t.thread_ts, c.display_name;

parameters.text: This draft was already handled by someone else, or replaced by a newer draft. Nothing was sent.

parameters.query:
-- The reply didn't reach the client: put the draft back to "pending" so someone can try again.
-- Values in order: 1 draft id, 2 what Slack said (passed through for the note in #support-queue)
update drafts
set status = 'pending', decided_by = null, decided_at = null, draft = draft - 'sent_reply'
where id = $1::uuid and status in ('approved', 'edited')
returning id as draft_id, $2::text as slack_error;

parameters.query:
-- The client's limit now, for the pop-up. No row (an unknown client) ends the run quietly.
select display_name, drafts_per_hour from client_map where client_key = $1;

parameters.query:
-- May this Slack user use the buttons? Active members of the staff list only (migration 017). Always one row.
select is_staff($1) as is_staff;

parameters.text: :information_source: Sent to the client, but not saved as a past ticket for the agent to learn from: the client is paused or removed in the admin app, and saving would send the reply to OpenAI.

parameters.query:
-- Is the client still active, right before the reply goes to OpenAI for the search index? Read again here, not
-- taken from the click: a pause made while the reply was on its way to Slack must still stop it (a privacy hold
-- must not reach OpenAI). Always one row; a client no longer in the list counts as not active.
-- Values in order: 1 the ticket's channel
select coalesce((select c.status = 'active' from client_map c where c.channel_id = $1), false) as client_active;
